title: The best massage of my life!
text: The best massage of my life. I used to go with other companies in Barcelona but I fell in love this time! The attention, the technique, and the detail, everything has been wonderful.
author: Dra_orianagv

title: An experience to try
text: I went for a 60-minute thai&bali massage and got completely renovated. From the first moment you breathe calm and professionalism: the atmosphere is welcoming, caring and invites you to really disconnect. The massage was balanced, adapted to what my body needed, and you can see the technique and experience. An hour that flies by and leaves you feeling light, relaxed and wanting to repeat. Definitely a little oasis to treat yourself wellness. I'll repeat.
author: marceladG3522VB

title: Incredible and unforgettable experience.
text: The best birthday present! I have come out very happy and especially very relaxed. Upon entering I felt a clean, relaxing environment combined with the smell of oils. The girl who gave me the massage called Pimae very professional, attentive and showed a love for her work. I recommend it 100%.
author: 289yamilab

title: Relaxing 😎
text: Nice massage 💆🏻, the girls did a great job for me and my friend- we came out brand new 😂😂😂😂😂😂
author: Eleutirde_M

title: Excellent quality and clean
text: Excellent experience. We were walk-ins. Friendly reception. I had the Thai Bali (60 min). Masseuse completely stretched me out and had me contorting into a prezel. Left feeling boneless and relaxed. Friends massage also great and back pain massively reduced. Friend had the aromatherapy which was a lot more gentle. Clean toilets & showers available.
author: UnaLoftus

title: Very good indeed
text: It was not our first visit to this center as we had historically enjoyed it each time we come to Barcelona. They are professional, let you choose your oil of preference. We both enjoyed very much our massage of today: we asked for face, neck & shoulders as well as feet and legs. Highly recommended.
author: SHA12311

title: Fantastic experience
text: I have been going to Thai Spa Massage for a long time because when I work with computers, my back is contracted a lot. The experience is very relaxing and I always leave there as new. The masseuses are very professional and friendly. They have different oils to choose from and after the massage you can shower. It is a 100% recommended place.
author: Coastal24397517538

title: Best Massage Ever
text: This was a spur of the moment booking and all I can say is that it was ane of the best massages I have ever had. If you fancy treating yourself when in Barcelona I would highly recommend it.
author: TrailBlazer725870

title: I came out like floating, spectacular!
text:
Lovely local and wonderful experience, super attentive and friendly staff. 
They gave me the experience and I will repeat, for sure!
author: Tour47498216554

title: Authentic massage experience in the heart of Barcelona
text: Fantastic and very intense massage, really authentic and highly recommended. Nice, clean rooms in a great ambience. Very nice and professional staff
